package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

func TestLoadOAuthAuthenticationValidation(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		method  string
		wantErr string
	}{
		{"github missing client id", "github:
      enabled: true
      client_secret: secret
      redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", `provider "github": field "client_id": non-empty value is required`},
		{"github missing client secret", "github:
      enabled: true
      client_id: id
      redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", `provider "github": field "client_secret": non-empty value is required`},
		{"github missing redirect address", "github:
      enabled: true
      client_id: id
      client_secret: secret", `provider "github": field "redirect_address": non-empty value is required`},
		{"github whitespace client id", "github:
      enabled: true
      client_id: '   '
      client_secret: secret
      redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", `provider "github": field "client_id": non-empty value is required`},
		{"github missing org scope", "github:
      enabled: true
      client_id: id
      client_secret: secret
      redirect_address: http://localhost/callback
      allowed_organizations: [flipt]", `provider "github": field "scopes": must contain read:org when allowed_organizations is not empty`},
		{"github valid org scope", "github:
      enabled: true
      client_id: id
      client_secret: secret
      redirect_address: http://localhost/callback
      allowed_organizations: [flipt]
      scopes: [read:org]", ""},
		{"github disabled", "github:
      enabled: false", ""},
		{"oidc missing client id", "oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        foo:
          client_secret: secret
          redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", `provider "foo": field "client_id": non-empty value is required`},
		{"oidc missing client secret", "oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        foo:
          client_id: id
          redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", `provider "foo": field "client_secret": non-empty value is required`},
		{"oidc missing redirect address", "oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        foo:
          client_id: id
          client_secret: secret", `provider "foo": field "redirect_address": non-empty value is required`},
		{"oidc whitespace client secret", "oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        foo:
          client_id: id
          client_secret: '  '
          redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", `provider "foo": field "client_secret": non-empty value is required`},
		{"oidc valid", "oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        foo:
          client_id: id
          client_secret: secret
          redirect_address: http://localhost/callback", ""},
		{"oidc disabled", "oidc:
      enabled: false
      providers:
        foo: {}", ""},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
			config := fmt.Sprintf("authentication:
  session:
    domain: localhost
  methods:
    %s
", tt.method)
			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(config), 0600))

			result, err := Load(path)
			if tt.wantErr != "" {
				require.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
				require.Nil(t, result)
				return
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotNil(t, result)
		})
	}
}
